heading: Wednesday, October 2, 2024
topLine: Complete Lean formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem for regular primes.

items.headline: Complete Lean formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem for regular primes
items.summary: Alex Best, Christopher Birkbeck, Riccardo Brasca, Eric Rodriguez Boidi, Ruben van de Velde and Andrew Yang reported a complete Lean 4 proof of FLT for regular primes, including Kummer's lemma. This was a human formalization; Anthropic's 2026 FLT proof later relied on it for small exponents.
